theme.name: Speculator Studio Theme
theme.summary: A clean Astro starter for specification docs with reusable Speculator block and inline renderer UI components.
theme.description: Speculator Studio Theme is an Astro theme starter for teams writing technical standards and specification-style docs. It includes automatic dark/light mode, a reusable local component system, and Tailwind v4 token/utility styling around a renderer playground backed by Speculator.

features: Recursive BlockRenderer and InlineRenderer mapped to local UI primitives
Tailwind v4 tokenized theme variables and reusable utility/component layers
Automatic light and dark themes via prefers-color-scheme
Mermaid rendering aligned with active system theme
Spec-focused typography, callouts, code panels, and TOC
Playground route rendering local sample spec source
openItems: Replace workspace dependency with published @openuji/speculator version
Set production site URL in astro.config.mjs
Attach final screenshots and social preview image
